scope: AST/source/file SHA only. No live proc read, signals, prctl/ctypes or project import/execute, tests, Unity, network or Git.
positiveStaticFindings: Dedicated supervisor sets/verifies subreaper before the single root spawn and normalizes SIGCHLD.
WNOWAIT peek None does not mean empty; ECHILD only establishes echild when actual root exit is known.
Root exact waitpid single-consumer; adopted peek child is exact-waited without global waitpid status theft.
Signals use held pidfds with identity/UID/baseline checks; no numeric PID or process-group fallback.
Outer sends only cancellation TERM to its verified sentinel then waits; no PGID KILL that destroys the reaper first.
Pre-run persistent auxiliary evidence supports lane.run=None with later bytecopy; production default acceptance null is blocked.

openFindings.reason: After original root has been reaped, an adopted descendant may reuse that numeric PID; root branch repeatedly returns instead of exact-reaping the new child.
openFindings.fix: Use root-only branch while root_exit is None; after root reaping, same numeric PID is ordinary adopted child.

openFindings.reason: Checks helperSHA/high-level9 passed cases and Root but does not require actual fixture/driver executed source fullrefs; case originals may be absent.
openFindings.fix: Pin executed helper/fixture/runner sources and actual receipt/spec/lineage/stdout originals per required case, and Root-bind that exact source set/report.

openFindings.reason: Exited/reaped FDs retained until final close can exhaust descriptors; select.select additionally rejects FD>=FD_SETSIZE, including unguarded final tracker.live call.
openFindings.fix: Use poll and retire verified exited FDs while retaining identity tombstones, with failure-safe final receipt.

documentedBoundary: Pre-signal UID observation and kernel permission check do not atomically freeze target credentials. pidfd prevents PID reuse mis-targeting; no hostile credential-changing containment guarantee claimed.
